description:
## What to build

Package and toolchain fields interpolated into HTML rows (names, versions, release URLs, component names) are HTML-escaped with stdlib html.escape instead of raw f-string concatenation, closing the escaping/injection gap in _render_package_rows and _render_toolchain_rows.

Out of scope: swapping the templating engine (Jinja2 etc.) — the review kept that dependency decision out. This is a stdlib correctness fix only.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All dynamic values interpolated into row HTML pass through html.escape (attribute values escaped with quote=True where relevant)
- [ ] Tests cover a value containing HTML-special characters (e.g. &, <, >, quotes) and assert it is escaped
- [ ] No templating-engine dependency added
- [ ] Existing test suite green (docs/tests)

## Blocked by

- Inject template + css through render_html's interface (tb-9sd.1)
title: Escape interpolated values in row rendering
